breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and Periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only uses the Dirichlet boundary conditions ('Enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0'), completely ignoring the contradictory periodic instruction, thus aligning with the ground truth.
